notes: 2019 DialoGPT paper (arXiv 1911.00536v3). No safety eval tables or numbered toxicity/bias scores. Safety content is qualitative (Limitations and risks, footnotes on toxic outputs and a toxicity-control demo). Training-data offensive-language filters are methods, not topic coverage. Skipped capability evals: DSTC-7 (Table 2: NIST/BLEU/METEOR/Entropy/Dist), 6K Reddit multi-reference (Table 3), human preference for relevance/informativeness/human-like (Tables 7–8), commonsense examples (Table 4). No printed page numbers; page is PDF index. Mapped 117M/345M/762M to DialoGPT-small/medium/large checkpoints. fileUrl is the arXiv PDF because the seed URL is the abs page.
